verdict.rationale: PayPal provides event-driven building blocks: webhooks post to your server whenever a subscribed event type occurs. It also has a few preset automations, such as automatic invoice payment reminders, automated payment recovery for failed subscription payments, and a setting to block payments in currencies you don't hold. However, there is no documented user-defined rule engine; the logic that turns an event into an action must be built on your own server via the APIs. Missing for 10: a native rule builder for event-to-action workflows, configurable conditions and actions beyond fixed presets, and hands-on corroboration.
